problem: The awrw_show and awrw_store evidence came from different candidate module snapshots; an earlier awrw_store Ghidra export also truncated its function body to 816 bytes instead of the stock 856-byte ELF extent.

correction: Built a current two-callback candidate with the pinned Docker toolchain, verified reproducibility, imported that exact module into Ghidra, extended awrw_store to the independently verified ELF symbol size, and scoped both functions from that same export.
